scope: Pinned source/control-flow inspection only; no GPU execution, operator timing or actual dispatch trace. Narrows an earlier hypothesis without proving the slowdown cause.
bounds: The qwen3_5_moe registry dispatches ordinary affine weights (no mxtq format) to Qwen35MoEModel, a Qwen35Model subclass without a prepare override; the nested text model type alone is not a registry route.

Qwen35TextModel and Qwen35Model conform to LLMModel without a prepare override. The default LLMModel.prepare chunks larger prompts at windowSize (256 in this committed profile), returning a remainder no larger than that window.

The ordinary attentionWithCacheUpdate route calls scaledDotProductAttention without forceFused; its Swift default is false. Quantized KV and optional multi-row routes are distinct and should not be assumed selected from source inspection.

For non-NAX D256, the new fused full-attention exception requires causal query length at least2048 and query/key lengths equal. Otherwise use_fallback returns true for D256 query length greater than8.

Ordinary 256-row prefill chunks therefore do not reach the changed wn=2 fused D256 tile through that default path. Do not use the wn change as an explanation or prepare a tile-revert experiment for these chunks.
Single-token loaded decode takes a different vector attention path; the new TK4/TK1 selection remains a conditional diagnostic candidate. Actual runtime dtype/dispatch still requires tracing.
